summary.en: A row of feature cards turns over one by one; each back answers its front with one big number, a before/after bar and a label.
summary.zh: 一排功能卡逐张翻面，每张背面用一个大数字、一组前后对照条和一行标签回答正面的功能。

fits: Features and what each one brought, three or four pairs read as a run of results (feature → outcome).
notFor: Backs unrelated to their fronts (the turn becomes a decorative card swap); more than four cards; outcomes that need more than one number and a line.

intent.en: "So what?" answered card by card: each feature turns over to show what it brought, so the row reads as a run of results.
intent.zh: 逐张回答“所以呢？”：每个功能翻过来亮出它带来的结果，一排读作成果连报。

content.en: 3–4 cards: front a name (≤ 14 chars, Chinese ≤ 6 characters) and a line (≤ 32 chars, Chinese ≤ 13); back one number (≤ 6 chars), a label (≤ 20 chars, Chinese ≤ 9) and optional before/after values; a headline.
content.zh: 3–4 张卡：正面名称（≤ 14 字符、中文 ≤ 6 字）加一行说明（≤ 32 字符、中文 ≤ 13 字）；背面一个数字（≤ 6 字符）、一行标签（≤ 20 字符、中文 ≤ 9 字）和可选的前后对照值；外加一个标题。

fits.zh: 几个功能和各自带来的结果，三四对读成一串成果（功能 → 结果）。

notFor.zh: 背面和正面无关（翻面成了花哨换卡）；多于四张；结果要不止一个数字加一行字。

en: Front and back must be a cause and its result; an unrelated back makes the flip a decorative swap.
A soft snap on each card's landing makes the run read as a rhythm.
zh: 正反两面必须是因果一对；翻出无关内容就只是花哨换图。
每张翻停配一声轻“啪”，连报的节奏才出来。

upstream.name: 卡片翻面揭示
upstream.summary: 功能卡 3D 翻面揭示——卡片沿 Y 轴翻 180°，正面 UI 翻到侧棱最薄处掠过一道随角度移动的受光，背面揭出大号结论数字，逐张错峰扫过整排
upstream.use: "功能→成果"的成对叙事：一排功能卡逐张翻出各自的指标/结论；元素级转场卡

overlaps.note: device-flip turns one window edge-on to swap its page (a hidden cut); flip-row turns a row over to show each card's other side, overshooting to 194° and springing back
louvre turns many slats to change the whole page; flip-row turns whole cards, one meaning each
